content:
Maya (support): escalating AuroraMetrics (trial) 08:14 UTC. Customers hitting 500s on /v1/embeddings and slow generate responses during onboarding demos. They said this blocks their exec demo next hour. Need CS comms + workaround.
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-7999 \u2014 embed/generation errors region=us-central1. Alert sent.
Hannah (csm): joining. Is this scoped to a single pool/account or broader? I can draft a short note to Aurora and propose an onboarding reschedule if needed.
Diego (support-eng): quick sampling from the proxy and model pool: 
```
[08:15:02] req=2a4c path=/v1/embeddings status=500 backend=pool-aur-2 err=oom
[08:15:10] req=2a4d path=/v1/generate status=200 latency=18012ms backend=pool-aur-1
```
Looks like memory pressure on pool-aur-2 and some requests routed to a slower pool with high latency.
Ravi (sre): confirmed node OOM events on pool-aur-2, autoscaler attempted replacement but model load times are ~80s. I9m moving traffic to warm pool and increasing warm replicas. ETA ~12m.
Maya (support): Aurora PM messaged support: "we're about to present to 6 execs, this is critical."
Hannah (csm): draft comms (short + proactive). Edit pls:
"Hi Aurora team 14 - we're aware of intermittent errors affecting your trial today. Our engineers found memory pressure on one of the pools and have routed your traffic to a warm pool; we're also increasing replica capacity. Expect stable behavior within ~15 minutes. We can reschedule your exec demo if you'd prefer, and we'll provide a one-time 2-week extension for the impacted trial. Apologies for the disruption. - Hannah, CSM"
Diego (support-eng): add: we can temporarily reduce per-request chunking for their account and disable client-side streaming to reduce concurrency; will require a settings flip. That should reduce OOMs immediately but may affect UX.
Ravi (sre): routing action and autoscaler log snapshot:
```
action=route pool=warm-pool-aur time=08:22 region=us-central1
action=scale pool=warm-pool-aur desired=6 actual=2 time=08:23
```
Post-route metrics: p50=360ms p95=1.2s error_rate=0.8% (was ~7%). Monitoring alert will clear on 5m stable.
Hannah (csm): please push the settings change and offer the reschedule + 2-week extension + $400 credit. I'll prepare the follow-up email template and add renewal-watch until postmortem.
Maya (support): DM to Aurora: "We've routed traffic to a warm pool and applied temporary settings to reduce errors. Latency improving; would you like to reschedule the exec demo or continue now? We can also extend your trial by 2 weeks and add a $400 credit."
Aurora (external): "Thanks, latency better now. We'd like to continue but appreciate the extension if things degrade. We'll take a short sync in 30m."
Diego (support-eng): post-incident checklist for CS & PMs:
- collect OOM traces + node logs 08:00-08:30 UTC
- record settings toggles + approver
- autoscaler and model-load timings
- customer-visible timeline + credit/extension confirmation
Hannah (csm): assigning owner: Hannah. I'll update account health, mark renewal-watch, and draft a postmortem summary for Aurora by EOD. Closing thread here; continuing in the follow-up invite.
Maya (support): closing initial thread ".
